name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router patterns: Server Components, streaming, routing, data fetching/caching, SSR/SSG, and Server Actions. Use for new apps, Pages Router migrations, full-stack features, or React Server Component optimization.

## Choose rendering
- Server Components (server only): data fetching, heavy computation, secrets.
- Client Components (browser): interactivity, hooks, browser APIs.
- Static (build time): rarely changing content; Dynamic (request time): personalized/real-time data.
- Streaming: progressive rendering for large pages or slow data.

## App Router files
`layout.tsx` shared wrapper; `page.tsx` route; `loading.tsx` Suspense loading UI; `error.tsx` error boundary; `not-found.tsx` 404; `route.ts` API; `template.tsx` remounted layout; `default.tsx` parallel-route fallback; `opengraph-image.tsx` OG generation.

## Examples / paths
- `app/layout.tsx`: `Inter` from `next/font/google`, metadata, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`, providers.
- `app/page.tsx`: async Server Component; `fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })`.
- `app/products/page.tsx`: await `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`; use `Suspense`, filters, pagination.
- `components/products/ProductList.tsx`: colocated fetch with `next: { tags: ['products'] }`; check `res.ok`, throw on failure.
- `components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx`: client `useState`, `useTransition`; call `addToCart`.
- `app/actions/cart.ts`: `cookies`, `revalidateTag`, `redirect`; Server Actions for cart/checkout, validate fields, redirect to confirmation.
- `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`; `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx`; `app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/loading.tsx`: parallel `analytics`/`team` slots and independent loading.
- Photo modal structure: `app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx` intercepts; `app/photos/[id]/page.tsx` full page. Root `app/layout.tsx` receives `modal`.
- `app/product/[id]/page.tsx`: fetch product first; stream reviews and recommendations inside separate `Suspense` boundaries.
- `app/api/products/route.ts`: `NextRequest`, `NextResponse`; GET query params, POST JSON, return 201.
- `app/api/products/[id]/route.ts`: await `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`; return 404 if missing.
- `app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`: `generateMetadata`, `generateStaticParams`, `notFound`; metadata/OG images.

## Caching
`fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" })` fresh; `{ cache: "force-cache" }` forever; `{ next: { revalidate: 60 } }` ISR; `{ next: { tags: ["products"] } }` tag. Invalidate with `revalidateTag`/`revalidatePath` from `next/cache` in Server Actions.

## Guidelines
**Start with Server Components** - Add 'use client' only when needed
**Colocate data fetching** - Fetch data where it's used
**Use Suspense boundaries** - Enable streaming for slow data
**Leverage parallel routes** - Independent loading states
**Use Server Actions** - For mutations with progressive enhancement
**Don't pass serializable data** - Server → Client boundary limitations
**Don't use hooks in Server Components** - No useState, useEffect
**Don't fetch in Client Components** - Use Server Components or React Query
**Don't over-nest layouts** - Each layout adds to the component tree
**Don't ignore loading states** - Always provide loading.tsx or Suspense
